title: Smoked Salmon Suspiro Tartine
description: A French-inspired appetizer featuring smoked salmon, topped with a rich and creamy suspiro sauce, served on toasted bamboo shoots.

ingredients.name: Suspiro Sauce (see notes)
ingredients.notes: Store-bought or homemade suspiro sauce made with hot chocolate, sugar, and milk

instructions: Rinse the bamboo shoots and slice them into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
Place the bamboo shoots on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and toast in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Meanwhile, mix the suspiro sauce with the hot water and peruvian lime juice in a small bowl.
To assemble the tartine, place a toasted bamboo shoot round on a plate, top with a slice of smoked salmon, and spoon the suspiro sauce mixture over the top.
Garnish with fresh chives and a sprinkle of limeno zest.
